description: This file implements SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol) socket operations, including address resolution, connection, binding, event subscription, and data transmission, with support for notifications and socket options.

classes.name: SCTPAddr
classes.description: Represents an SCTP network address with IP addresses and port.

classes.name: SCTPConn
classes.description: Represents an SCTP connection with methods for data transfer, socket options, and address management.

classes.name: SCTPListener
classes.description: Represents an SCTP listener socket for accepting incoming connections.

classes.name: SndRcvInfo
classes.description: Contains information for sending and receiving SCTP messages, such as stream, ppid, and tsn.

classes.name: SndInfo
classes.description: Contains information for sending SCTP messages, such as stream id and ppid.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Represents the status of an SCTP association.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Function type for handling SCTP notifications.

classes.name: SocketConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for creating SCTP sockets, including control functions and initial message settings.

methods.name: SubscribeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to specific SCTP events for notifications.

methods.name: SCTPGetPrimaryPeerAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the primary peer address for the SCTP connection.

methods.name: SCTPLocalAddr
methods.description: Gets local addresses associated with the SCTP connection.

methods.name: SCTPRemoteAddr
methods.description: Gets remote addresses associated with the SCTP connection.
